python - <<'EOF'
from tinydb import TinyDB, Query
from tinydb.operations import append
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert_multiple([{'p':'x','tags':['a']},{'p':'x'},{'p':'y'}])
db.update(append('tags','u'), Query().p=='x')
print(db.all())

# non-list
db2 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db2.insert({'tags':'no'})
try:
    db2.update(append('tags','u'))
except TypeError as e:
    print('TypeError', e)
print(db2.all())

# tuple field
db3 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db3.insert({'tags':('a',)})
try:
    db3.update(append('tags','u'))
except TypeError as e:
    print('tuple TypeError', e)

# update_multiple
db4 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db4.insert({'tags':['a']})
db4.update_multiple(append('tags','u'))
print(db4.all())
EOF

python - <<'EOF'
from tinydb import TinyDB, Query
from tinydb.operations import append
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage

db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert({'tags':['a']})
print(db.update_multiple([(append('tags','u'), Query().tags.exists())]))
print(db.all())

# field exists but is None
db2 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db2.insert({'tags':None})
try:
    db2.update(append('tags','u'))
except TypeError as e:
    print('None ->', e)

# nested field? issue says field name; check dotted path support of other ops
from tinydb.operations import add
db3 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db3.insert({'a':{'b':1}})
try:
    db3.update(add('a.b', 1))
except Exception as e:
    print('dotted add ->', type(e).__name__, e)

# empty list
db4 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db4.insert({'tags':[]})
db4.update(append('tags','u'))
print(db4.all())

# value itself a list
db5 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db5.insert({'tags':['a']})
db5.update(append('tags',['b','c']))
print(db5.all())

# doc_ids path
db6 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db6.insert_multiple([{'tags':['a']},{'tags':['b']}])
print(db6.update(append('tags','u'), doc_ids=[1]))
print(db6.all())
EOF

# Probe: does append work when the same transform is reused across docs? (closure state)
from tinydb import TinyDB, Query
from tinydb.operations import append
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db.insert_multiple([{'tags':['a']},{'tags':['b']}])
op = append('tags','u')

# Probe: value appended is same object (aliasing) - acceptable?

v = {'x':1}
db2.insert({})
db2.update(append('tags', v))
print(db2.all(), db2.all()[0]['tags'][0] is v)
EOF
